title: Florida Blossom Minstrel Show
summary: Humphrey describes three years with a tent minstrel show and its twelve-piece band, moving daily.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Who were you traveling with, exactly?
Well, that, that, that particularly, I was, I stayed with them three years. Florida Blossom Minstrel Show, one-nighter.
Well, what, what was the, who would have been playing, I mean, what was the, you were playing from band, what other musicians were you?

Oh, we had about twelve piece band, brass band, because they played for the shows too, you know. Yeah. We had twelve pieces, twelve, at the time fourteen. Really? The show consisted of about thirty-five, forty people altogether. Man, women, chorus girls, singers, comedians, violets, and...
But was it like a circus?

Yeah, like a circus, under a tent. Tent, big, spread a big tent. Yeah. Every day, move every day. The sun, the way I was gonna show on Monday, while then they move in there that Sunday morning, see. We'd be there Monday morning. That's the only time to stay two days. Very seldom with your, uh, theater, well, when we did a three, theater day, why, we'd stay there three days.
Yeah. It just... Gosh, it must have got towering, all that moving, all that moving, all that moving, the tent around, and all that...

Well, they... ...packing, you know what? They had regular men to do that. All we did was play. And instead of the storm come up, well then everybody's pitching, you know, trying to up the loaded tent to keep from destroying it. Well, then we didn't do anything. And we were sleeping vans right on the same lot where the tent would be for us. Yeah. Well, right out, you're sleeping thing right in the tent. And we had a canvas tent cookhouse.
